_notes: lanePERF4 v100. Read by Scripts/PerfMem.cs (runtime) and Editor/PerfMemApply.cs (editor). Every switch is OFF (or today's value) by default, so the shipped look and memory are unchanged until a switch is turned on. Without a rebuild: -permem:E1,E3 (only these ON) | -permem:none | -nopermem:E3 (json minus these). The shadow cuts A1 / A1b / A4 live in perf_fixes.json (lanePERF3, -perffix:); A2 is below; A3 is an HDRP-asset value (asset_variants/make_variant4.py --A3 / --A2).

E1.note: RUNTIME half: destroys the inactive MetaHumanHead object (MHHeadBuilder + MHHeadAttach, HDRP materials in keepAlive) after the scene load and unloads its textures from RAM/VRAM. The BUILD half (stop shipping about 87 MB of textures + native plugin + shader variants) is Editor/PerfMemApply.cs step E1 (scene edit, the dev runs it). mhhead_attach.json enabled=false today, so the head is never built and Joan uses the Tripo head.

E3.note: QualitySettings.globalTextureMipmapLimit: 0 = full size (today, Ultra), 1 = drop the top mip of EVERY texture (4096 -> 2048, 2048 -> 1024). Saves RAM + VRAM at once, even for the uncompressed glTFast textures. This IS look-affecting (sharpness at close range): look gate it. Disabled = untouched.

E4.note: Mip streaming. Only textures whose importer has streamingMipmaps=true take part: the E5 plan sets that on the TextureImporter files; the glTFast sub-asset textures never stream (no importer flag), so on this project the budget only governs the png/exr/jpg groups.

A2.note: Mixed cached directional shadows: the sun HDAdditionalLightData.shadowUpdateMode OnEnable + alwaysDrawDynamicShadows so static casters (A1b marks them, perf_fixes.json) are cached and only the fighters are redrawn each frame. NEEDS the asset flag hdShadowInitParams.allowDirectionalMixedCachedShadows 0 -> 1 (make_variant4.py --A2): without it HDRP ignores the light setting. A moving sun would show a stale shadow: the sun is static in the duel.
